title: Drinking and marijuana among musicians in the 1920s
summary: Barnes says musicians drank but marijuana ('tea') was rare in the 1920s and not in Morton's band.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
